Market today:
The market's mood is cautious. Rising oil prices and persistent wholesale inflation, coupled with the ECB's rate hike, signal continued pressure from higher rates. This environment typically weighs on growth-oriented tech and chip names.

Your holdings:
SOXL (-54.07%) and SPAL (-36.18%) are your most urgent concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs showing deep losses and are flagged "SELL." Remember, margin amplifies these drops. QQQ (-0.96%) and SMH (-11.72%) are also flagged "TRIM."

Watch:
Keep a close eye on your leveraged positions for any further decay. Also, watch how the broader market reacts to ongoing inflation data and central bank rhetoric, as this directly impacts your tech-heavy book.

Bottom line:
Prioritize risk management on your leveraged positions; they are bleeding capital fast.
plays: SOXL / SPAL: These leveraged "SELL" positions are bleeding. Re-evaluate your stops immediately, as current ones are far from market price.
QQQ / SMH: Consider trimming these positions as flagged, especially given broader market inflation concerns.
AAPL: Watch for a potential entry around 313.41-311.84 with a stop at 309.19, supported by the iPhone news and scanner.
